sloka: भूतान्याकाशचारीणी तमूचुः प्लवगोत्तमम् ।भीममद्य कृतं कर्म महत्सत्त्वं त्वया हतम् ॥५-१-१९७॥
transliteration: bhūtānyākāśacārīṇī tamūcuḥ plavagottamam ।bhīmamadya kṛtaṁ karma mahatsattvaṁ tvayā hatam ॥5-1-197॥

translations.english: "O great jumper a great deed has been done by you today in killing that fierce creature. O great monkey fulfil your mission without any obstruction.
